> A wireless macropad with a joystick near the thumb which allows the user to move the mouse with a trackpad or mouse, designed like a split keyboard with a screen and rotary encoder for volume.

## PCB Routing

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/cff2e89bb671e5cb84f00286de3f70f6faf4529499fc479e1b04c2c440e7c66b.png)
